questions.question: Who among the following has received the USA's prestigious National Book Award for Fiction 2020 for his satirical cinematic novel 'Interior Chinatown'?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__Charles YU____.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Charles Yu won the** National Book Award for fiction for his mind-bending satire, “Interior Chinatown**,” a sendup of Hollywood and Asian-American stereotypes.
 
• **Tamara Payne **worked as a principal researcher her bestselling books include "**The Dead are Arising**".
 
• **Walter Ellis Mosley** is an American novelist most widely recognized for his crime fiction.
 
• **Morgan Giles **was a Royal Navy officer during the Second World War, who later served as a Conservative Member of Parliament of the UK.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Book Awards were established in **1936 by the American Booksellers Association abandoned during World War II,** and re-established by three book industry organizations in **1950.**
 
• **Non-U.S. authors **and publishers were eligible for the pre-war awards. Now they are presented to U.S. authors for books published in the United States roughly during the award year.

questions.question: In which year did Rudolf Virchow published an essay titled ‘Cellular Pathology’ in which he famously declared that "every cell arises from another cell”?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1855**__.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• In 1855, at the age of 34, he published his now famous aphorism “omnis cellula e cellula” (“every cell stems from another cell”).
 
• With this approach Virchow launched the field of cellular pathology.
 
• He stated that all diseases involve changes in normal cells, that is, all pathology ultimately is cellular pathology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rudolf Virchow's theory stated that just as animals are unable to arise without previously existing animals, cells are unable to arise without previously existing cells.
 
• This book is one of the towering classics in the history of the development of modern medicine.

questions.question: Which of the following autobiographies is written by former English footballer, David Beckham published in 2003 ?

__
 
• **My side** is an autobiography written by former English footballer, **David Beckham** published in **2003**.
 
• **David Robert Joseph Beckham** is an English former professional footballer, the current president and co-owner of Inter Miami CF, and the co-owner of Salford City.
 
• He is known for his range of passing, crossing ability, and bending free-kicks as a right winger, **David** **Beckham** has been hailed as one of the greatest and most recognizable midfielders of his generation, as well as one of the best set-piece specialists of all time.
 
• He is the **first** English player to win league titles in four countries: England, Spain, the United States, and France.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• __**The Greatest**__: My Own Story is a 1975 autobiography of heavyweight boxer **Muhammad Ali.**
 
• __**Standing my Ground**__ is the book written by **Matthew Hayden**.
